items.author: Jack Clark
items.title: Import AI 479: Spacewar; low-latency tasks versus LLMs; Genie 4
takeaways: The excerpt mentions a benchmark (Realtime-Bench) showing current AI models struggle with low-latency, time-sensitive tasks, which matters if your product needs instant decision-making like live patient triage or real-time monitoring alerts.

If your health-tech product relies on quick back-and-forth interactions rather than slow, deliberate responses, do not expect current LLMs to handle that well yet; plan for human oversight or simpler rule-based systems in those spots.
The excerpt is too thin to draw firm conclusions beyond this, so treat it as a signal to watch for more detail rather than a reason to change your build plans today.
